title: Static admin kubeconfig in CI
summary: The pipeline deploys with the output of az aks get-credentials --admin, stored as a repo secret. It's a client certificate for the cluster's local admin account. It bypasses Entra ID, Conditional Access and Azure RBAC, and stays valid until the cluster's certificates are rotated.
notes: Local admin credentials can't be scoped, can't be tied to the pipeline, and show up in audit logs only as a generic admin user.
Fix: disable local accounts on the cluster. The pipeline signs in with a federated managed identity (workload identity federation) that holds an AKS RBAC role on just the namespaces it deploys to.
The same anti-pattern elsewhere: long-lived ServiceAccount token Secrets copied into CI, on any Kubernetes.

nodes.label: KUBECONFIG_ADMIN (repo secret)
nodes.warning: Replayable from anywhere; not tied to Entra ID.

nodes.warning: Local account: bypasses Entra ID, Conditional Access and Azure RBAC.
